Common questions

How much does it cost?

Vocals are $50 an hour ($40/hr when you book 2+ hours). Mixing $30 and mastering $20 a song. Grupos: $150 a studio song or $120 a live song, each with up to 4 hours (then $40/hr). Live music videos $250, reels $50, photo sessions $100.

Do I need a deposit?

Yes, 25% locks in your date. For example, a $150 grupo song takes a $37.50 deposit. Zelle, Cash App, Apple Pay or cash.

Have you recorded grupos like mine?

Yes. We've worked with 50+ bands and grupos, especially sierreño and norteño: Nivel 15, Indebido, Marca Exigente, Herencia De Rancho, Gallos De La Sierra and more. Los Serenos even came from California to record their EP, “Desde Synq Studios Rockford, Illinois (Live)”.

Do you speak Spanish?

Yes. We work with clients in Spanish and English.

Do you travel?

Yes. If we set up on location or drive more than 45 minutes, there's a $100 travel & setup fee.

Can you mix a song recorded somewhere else?

Yes. Mixing $30, mastering $20.

Where are you located?

4040 Charles St, Rockford, IL 61108. We also work with artists across the Chicago area.
